title: IDA symbols and Schatten--Lorentz theory for Toeplitz operators on weighted Fock spaces
summary: We study complex-symbol Toeplitz operators on weighted Fock spaces. The weight has a uniformly positive and bounded real Hessian. Local analytic distance is unchanged when an entire function is added to the symbol. We combine this distance with a complex ball average or the Berezin transform to control the local size of the symbol. Under a matching Lorentz condition on the distance, we characterize membership in every Schatten--Lorentz class.
